General information for the Applicants/Candidates:
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of West Bengal.
2. Age relaxation will be given for the reserved candidates as per govt. norms.
3. The applicant must have knowledge of local language.
4. Only online applications will be accepted. Application forms not properly filled in or incomplete
application forms are liable to be cancelled. If the details of online application submitted by the
applicant differs with the original testimonials, that application shall be treated as cancelled.
5. If proper full signature and photograph are not uploaded at the time of online application that
application shall also be treated as cancelled.
6. The essential qualifications mentioned are the minimum and mere possession of the same does not
entitle the candidate to claim selection. All the essential qualification must be obtained on or before
the publication of advertisement.
7. Experience will be calculated after obtaining the required academic qualification for the above
mentioned position to till the last date of online application.
8. Caste /EWS Certificate issued on or before the last date of online application by the competent
authorities of West Bengal (wherever applicable) only will be accepted.
9. Hard copy/Print copy of the online registration form may be downloaded from the link
https://hr.wbhealth.gov.in/ and should be retained by all the applicants for document verification
purpose. Without registration form, candidates will not be entertained for original testimonials
verification by the authority. No need to send hard copy/print copy of the online registration form by
post.
10. Online Registration number should be retained by all applicants for future reference. Employer is
not liable to give any information regarding the online Registration number in future.

12. Application fee (non refundable) i) For General Caste – Rs.100/- ii) For Reserved Category - Rs.50/-
The online deposition of application fees can only be done through net banking/ UPI payment or
credit/debit card system through an online interface. After registration, payment is to be done using
application ID & Date of Birth. After successful payment, candidates need to re-login for final
submission of application. During the registration/application process Pop-up is to be accepted.
Please do not deposit fee more than one time.
13. The candidates, if found ineligible at any stage of recruitment process, will not be called for the
subsequent stages of the selection process.
14. The decision of the competent authorities regarding the recruitment is final.
15. The competent authorities may cancel the recruitment process at any stage of the selection process.
16. Any Addendum / deletion / corrigendum/any update shall be posted on the website of Swasthya
Bhawan i.e.www.wbhealth.gov.in and the official website of Birbhum district i.e.
www.birbhum.nic.in
